analysis.channel_combination: mean stereo power; no mono waveform summation
analysis.onset: first 1ms RMS envelope crossing a noise-aware threshold near -45dB of the first-second peak
analysis.pitch: joint stiff-string fit to dominant partial peaks; normalized f1 convention
analysis.partial_levels: Hann-window power integrated around each fitted partial, with bandwidth covering window leakage and unison splitting
analysis.decay: Theil-Sen regression of partial-band dB power from 0.25 to 3.5 seconds; not a physical loss identification in isolation
analysis.gain: one scalar from 0.05–0.75s RMS, applied unchanged to all windows
analysis.limits: one piano/recording setup; microphone, room, library editing, unknown physical hammer velocities and acquisition pedal state are confounds; metrics are not perceptual scores
analysis.extreme_pitch_audit: New TRAIN extremes only: wide +/-200-cent component scan and strong-family support; ambiguous identity retained rather than equating dominant component with fundamental.

right_censoring_policy: Respect per-row analysis_windows_seconds/envelope support; never pad missing recorded tails. Fixed broadband edges remain31.25Hz upward; separate QC includes20–31.25Hz.

samples.pitch_measurement_basis: Frozen key-family estimate checked against a wide component/family audit.

edge_pitch_diagnostic.decision: Candidate family/dominant agreement checked; retain candidate f1 and any adequately supported B.
edge_pitch_diagnostic.limits: The wide scan exposes missed components, not their physical origin. Window resolution/nonstationarity/unison or noise can shift peaks. No physical chirp, mislabeling, string identity or stretch cause is asserted.

samples.censoring: Last analysis window and envelope stop at actual source end. No padding or extrapolation; decay fits use only observed STFT frames.

attack.definition: 5ms RMS envelope rise within first150ms; not hammer contact duration
